title: Smile and Visitor
author: Gideon Coldharbour
blurb: Gideon Ishikawa, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
